| Status | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Legal | 3,645 |
| Restricted | 151 |
| Banned | 14 |

These three status categories are distributed across artifact cards in the vintage format, with the vast majority being Legal, followed by a smaller number of Restricted cards, and a few Banned ones.
